baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate at word 2 is held together with the bounded-place noun at word 4 by the second-person nominal construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Removal of prohibition operates inside a delimited tract. The resulting status is deliberately two-sided: the addressee may be licensed within the land, or restraint protecting the addressee may have been lifted so that the addressee is exposed there.

activation_trace.role: Removal of prohibition supplies the predicate's legal opening and preserves both permission and being treated as permissible as live valences.
A bounded tract supplies the jurisdictional edge within which the released status matters.

changed_reading.before: You are simply present in this city.
changed_reading.after: Within this bounded land, your status is one of released prohibition: either licensed agency or dangerous exposure remains possible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can name alighting or co-dwelling, while word 4 can name both a place and staying in it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus line doubles the semantics of emplacement: the addressee alights and co-dwells, and the land is a place held through residence. This supports both temporary arrival and durable belonging without forcing a choice between them.

activation_trace.role: Alighting or settling supplies the addressee's entry into and occupancy of the place.
Co-dwelling spouse or neighbor adds a relational, not merely geometric, form of inhabitation.
Residence and staying in a place make the land an abode to which one adheres over time.

changed_reading.before: You happen to be located in this land.
changed_reading.after: You have alighted there as a co-resident, with arrival, neighborhood, and durable belonging all latent in the predication.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of word 2 and word 4 permits a material contrast between displacement and adhesion.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root supplies loosening from a fixed place while the other supplies both bounded ground and pressing or sticking to it. The addressee can therefore be imagined as the mobile or dislodged element within an otherwise ground-fast territory.

activation_trace.role: Loosening or moving away from a place supplies mobility and release from fixed emplacement.
Pressing or sticking to the ground supplies the opposite material pole of immobilization.
The bounded tract contains the mobility-versus-adhesion contrast within one terrain.

changed_reading.before: The line fixes you at a location.
changed_reading.after: The line may instead distinguish you as loosened and mobile inside a land whose material pull is to bind bodies to the ground.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate at word 2 has a branch of an obligation, right, punishment, or event reaching its due point, attached here to the bounded land at word 4.
baseline_models.mechanism: Rather than naming only a stable status, the predicate can make the addressee's presence an event or claim that has arrived at maturity in relation to this land.

activation_trace.role: Something coming due or falling upon supplies an eventive pressure to an otherwise static nominal predicate.
The bounded land supplies the recipient or jurisdiction upon which the due event bears.

changed_reading.before: You possess a settled status in this land.
changed_reading.after: Your presence may be a claim, consequence, or turning point now coming due upon this land.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately repeated bounded land is first placed in an oath-bearing frame and then made the jurisdiction of released prohibition. Binding and unbinding consequently coexist: the place is rhetorically obligated even while the addressee's restraint, or the restraint around the addressee, is loosened.

activation_trace.role: Release from prohibition or covenant supplies the unbinding pole of the local paradox.
The bounded tract supplies one stable jurisdiction shared by the oath and the changed status.
An oath apportioned among its people supplies formal binding pressure and makes release answer a covenant-like constraint.
The same bounded tract is named in the oath frame, turning place into witness and jurisdiction rather than background.

structural_cues: 90:1 and 90:2 repeat the same preposition-demonstrative-land construction in immediate succession.
The discourse turns from an oath-bearing clause to a direct second-person predication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath, repeated bounded land, and release; I supply the claim that oath-binding and legal unbinding answer one another. A live alternative is that the repetition only intensifies place without creating a covenantal reversal.

changed_reading.before: The addressee merely has an exceptional status in a city.
changed_reading.after: The addressee's opening occurs inside an oath-bound jurisdiction, so freedom, exposure, and the land's claim remain knotted together.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generation and created humanity lead into hardship located at a center or heart. Those cues activate the land's chest/front branch and the focus predicate's settling branch, yielding an embodied city in whose central, strained chest the addressee has alighted.

activation_trace.role: Settling in a place locates the addressee as an inhabitant within the activated body-space.
The chest and front hollow turn the land from a map coordinate into an anatomically organized place.
Something generated from another supplies derivation and lineage to the addressee's emplacement.
Created emergence supplies the transition from lineage to embodied human existence.
Hardship and struggle give the city-body's central location pressure rather than prestige alone.
The middle or heart supplies a spatial center that aligns with the land's chest image.

structural_cues: 90:3 moves from parent to offspring, and 90:4 moves from created humanity to an interior condition.
The focus locative relation is followed by another construction that places a human within something.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, creation, hardship, center, chest, and settlement; I supply the city-as-body mapping and place the addressee at its strained center. The live alternative is ordinary natal residence followed by a separate claim about human hardship.

changed_reading.before: You reside somewhere inside a municipal boundary.
changed_reading.after: You have alighted in the city-body's chest or heart, where generated human life and strain concentrate.

context_deltas.mechanism: Supposition of unopposed capacity, piled wealth, and the denial of being seen test the legal-opening baseline. The focus status can no longer safely mean autonomous impunity: it is either a bounded permission under observation or the more dangerous condition of being exposed to another's capacity.

activation_trace.role: Licit status supplies the semantic opening that the later human can misread as unrestricted self-authorization.
Supposition supplies a possibly false mental model rather than an established fact about freedom.
Capacity that reaches action and possession supplies the contested power relation around the opened status.
Accumulated layers make the imagined license materially visible as wealth heaped upon wealth.
Sight by eye or insight defeats the fantasy that opened agency is unobserved agency.

structural_cues: 90:5 and 90:7 repeat the same estimating posture around capacity and visibility.
A first-person claim about expended, amassed wealth is enclosed by those two estimates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supposition, capacity, accumulation, and sight; I link the later human's imagined impunity to the focus legal opening. The live alternative is that the later human contrasts with, rather than continues, the second-person addressee.

changed_reading.before: Released prohibition gives the addressee unrestricted agency in the land.
changed_reading.after: Any license is bounded by capacity and sight, while the opposite valence remains live: the addressee may be the one rendered exposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cluster of eyes, tongue, and lips activates an opened-outlet branch for the focus predicate and a chest/front branch for the land. On this cross-domain reading, the bounded city becomes body-like and the addressee functions as one of its perceptive or speaking apertures.

activation_trace.role: An opened duct or outlet supplies permeability and passage to the focus predicate.
The chest and front hollow supply the body-scale frame in which an outlet can function.
The seeing eye supplies a receptive aperture and makes openness perceptive rather than merely legal.
The tongue as speech organ supplies an expressive channel through the opened body-space.
The lips supply the paired boundary that opens and closes the speaking outlet.

structural_cues: 90:8-9 enumerate paired eyes and lips around the singular tongue.
The organ sequence follows questions about seeing, making bodily permeability salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outlet, chest, and speech-perception organs; I supply the city-as-body and addressee-as-aperture mappings. The live alternative is that the organs concern individual accountability and do not redescribe the land.

changed_reading.before: You are legally or spatially situated in a bounded city.
changed_reading.after: You may be the city's open perceptive-speaking channel, a point where its bounded body becomes permeable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance, elevated terrain, perilous entry, and a hard rise convert the focus mobility branch into a route model. Being loosened from place is not ease or aimlessness; it is the capacity to move through bounded terrain toward a disclosed but difficult ascent.

activation_trace.role: Loosening from place supplies the mobile subject who can undertake a route.
The bounded tract supplies the containing terrain rather than an abstract moral backdrop.
Gentle indication toward a road supplies direction to mobility.
Elevation supplies the upward geometry of the disclosed alternatives.
Perils and road difficulties make movement costly and resistant.
A hard raised obstacle supplies the concrete threshold that released mobility must cross.

structural_cues: 90:10 discloses two elevated ways before 90:11-12 repeats the difficult obstacle.
The sequence moves from guidance to failed entry to explanation of the obstacle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guidance, elevation, difficult route, obstacle, loosening, and bounded land; I supply one continuous terrain model across them. The live alternative is a purely moral metaphor with no backward effect on the focus emplacement.

changed_reading.before: You are settled or licensed inside the land.
changed_reading.after: You are released from fixed emplacement so that you can traverse its guided, resistant terrain; freedom names an arduous capacity, not arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later opening of what is locked or interwoven and the freeing of a neck concretize the focus root's knot-loosening and prohibition-removal branches. The focus status can now be read not only as freedom possessed but as freedom capable of being enacted upon another bondage.

activation_trace.role: Untying a knot supplies the focus's latent operation of separating what has been bound.
Removal of prohibition supplies legal release alongside the material untying operation.
Opening a closure and separating an interlock gives the earlier release a concrete mechanism.
Freeing a pledged or captive neck transfers release from abstract status to social liberation.
The neck supplies the embodied bearer whose binding can be removed.

structural_cues: 90:13 immediately begins the packet's explanation of the difficult obstacle.
A compact construct links an act of opening directly to an embodied neck.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two release lexicons and an embodied captive; I supply the arrow from the addressee's own opened status to responsibility or capacity to open another's bondage. A live alternative is that the addressee is analogous to the released neck rather than its liberator.

changed_reading.before: The focus grants or removes restraint around one exceptional person.
changed_reading.after: The focus's private release becomes a prototype for transferable liberation: an opened person in the city can participate in opening another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus polarity between loosening from place and sticking to ground becomes social topography. Feeding amid exhausting hunger, loss of a caretaker, kinship, humbled poverty, and adhesion to dust place a mobile addressee inside a city containing bodies whose need immobilizes them.

activation_trace.role: Loosening from place supplies the addressee's relative mobility.
Sticking or pressing to the ground supplies the land's latent immobilizing pole.
Feeding another supplies the material transfer by which unequal mobility can be answered.
Hunger joined to exhaustion supplies the force that makes vulnerability bodily and movement costly.
Severance from a caretaker supplies a social form of unmooring that differs from chosen mobility.
Kinship supplies an existing relation that makes the vulnerable person near rather than anonymous.
Humiliation through poverty supplies social immobility beneath the apparent calm of staying.
Poverty figured as sticking to dust materially completes the ground-binding contrast.

structural_cues: 90:14-16 move from an act of provision to hunger, a severed dependent with kinship, and a poor person associated with dust.
The beneficiaries are located through bodily and relational conditions rather than named as an abstract class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mobility, ground adhesion, feeding, hunger, severance, kinship, poverty, and dust; I supply the social-asymmetry arrow from the addressee's release to responsibility toward immobilized bodies. A live alternative is that these are examples of the obstacle with no special backward relation to the focus addressee.

changed_reading.before: Being loosened in the city is an individual privilege or exposure.
changed_reading.after: It is relative mobility inside a ground-binding social field, where freedom is measured against hungry, unsupported, and dust-pressed neighbors.

context_deltas.mechanism: Co-dwelling and released prohibition are followed by secure trust, reciprocal connection, self-restraint, and mercy or kinship. The opened person is not atomized; release is reconfigured as freedom inside voluntarily renewed civic bonds.

activation_trace.role: Co-dwelling spouse or neighbor supplies the relational baseline for civic belonging.
Removal of prohibition supplies the release that must be distinguished from social isolation.
Staying in a place supplies the durable shared setting in which reciprocal bonds operate.
Security and trust in the heart supply an inwardly stable form of openness.
Connecting one thing to another supplies the counter-motion that binds released persons into relation.
Mutual counsel among a group makes the bond reciprocal rather than imposed from one side.
Holding the self back from panic supplies voluntary restraint within freedom.
Kinship supplies a bodily-social bond that makes mercy structurally near.

structural_cues: 90:17 combines belonging with two reciprocal exhortations rather than isolated virtues.
Restraint and mercy are paired inside the same communal construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies co-residence, release, security, connection, reciprocity, restraint, and kinship; I supply the sequence in which release is rebound as chosen civic obligation. A live alternative is that the later virtues describe a separate community without redefining the focus status.

changed_reading.before: Release means exemption from bonds in the city.
changed_reading.after: Release clears coercive restraint so that trust, reciprocal counsel, patience, and mercy can become the bonds of co-residence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The singular addressee's open status inside a boundary is followed by collective companionship sorted to right and left, then by fire enclosed under a tight seal. Openness becomes a threshold state: belonging and direction determine whether boundedness remains inhabitable or hardens into inescapable closure.

activation_trace.role: An opened outlet supplies the permeability later reversed by a sealed enclosure.
Removal of prohibition supplies legal openness before the later social sorting.
A bounded but not necessarily sealed tract supplies the initial container.
Companionship and sustained association turn the singular status into group belonging on one side.
The repeated companionship branch forms a parallel group on the opposing side.
The right hand or rightward side supplies one direction of the social partition.
The left or northern side supplies the opposed direction of the partition.
Kindled fire supplies the material content made inescapable by closure.
Closing over a thing supplies enclosure as the direct topological opposite of an opened outlet.
The non-dominant mapped branch of tightly shutting a door sharpens closure into an impassable threshold.

structural_cues: 90:18 and 90:19 repeat the same companionship construction while changing its side.
90:20 follows the second group with an enclosure described as closed upon them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, a bounded tract, parallel companion groups, opposed sides, fire, and two mapped closure branches; I supply a trajectory from provisional openness to sorted and sealed space. A live alternative is that final closure applies only to one group and need not redefine the earlier focus status.

changed_reading.before: The addressee's open status is a permanent property of residence in the land.
changed_reading.after: The status is a threshold before collective alignment: a bounded city can remain traversable, or its boundary can harden into a seal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping of the focus root and maps the land's brow-space onto a city-as-face. It remains branch-backed at both focus words and is later activated by the eye image, but downstream prose should label it speculative cross-domain wordplay rather than substitute ornament for the ordinary predicate.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2's non-dominant mapped ornament branch meets word 4's open-brow branch in the same predication.

activation_trace.role: Adornment supplies a bright or distinguished function for the addressee through the packet's non-dominant mapped root.
The clear space between the eyebrows supplies a face-like open field on which the addressee can appear.
Wide and beautiful eyes complete the later facial frame that activates the focus brow-space.

changed_reading.before: You occupy this land as resident or licensed person.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, you are the adornment or distinguishing mark set in the open face of the city.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ostrich-nest branch is remote from ordinary city usage, so this cannot carry the main reading. It remains anchored through settling plus the land's nesting-place branch, and generation, orphanhood, and womb imagery make the ecological analogy coherent; downstream prose should present it as a contained care-model.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The settling branch at word 2 can occur in the nesting-place branch activated at word 4.

activation_trace.role: Alighting in a place supplies habitation of the activated nest-space.
An ostrich nesting scrape supplies a vulnerable generative micro-landscape within the focus noun.
Birth and delivery supply the generative event for which a nest becomes functional.
Severance of offspring from a caretaker turns the nest image toward vulnerability and failed protection.
The womb supplies an interior shelter that parallels the nesting place and intensifies the care mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The city is a political or geographic container in which you dwell.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the city is a nesting ground, and your dwelling there places you inside a fragile ecology of birth, lost protection, and care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is syntactically and branch-distant because the due-or-falling sense is eventive while the focus predicate is nominal. It remains anchored in a packet branch and gains pressure from oath, measured capacity, and outcome; downstream prose should carry it as a possible event-structure, not as a settled lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 2's coming-due branch bears directly on the bounded jurisdiction at word 4.

activation_trace.role: A right, obligation, consequence, or punishment reaching its due point supplies the eventive focus.
The bounded tract supplies the jurisdiction upon which the due claim arrives.
An apportioned oath supplies a prior obligation whose maturation can be imagined as coming due.
Measured governance and considered apportioning supply the process by which a claim reaches its proper point.
An ending or outcome supplies the temporal consequence toward which the due event tends.

changed_reading.before: You hold a status while present in this land.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, your very presence is the land's oath, claim, or consequence arriving at its due point.

strongest_changes: The repeated land becomes an oath-bound jurisdiction in which legal opening can mean both licensed agency and dangerous exposure.
The route and liberation sequence converts release from a private status into arduous mobility and the capacity to unbind another.
Hunger, orphanhood, poverty, and dust turn the focus contrast between loosening and ground-adhesion into a social map of unequal mobility.
The final social partition and doubled closure inventory make the focus openness a threshold that can later harden into a seal.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots do not merely offer competing glosses; together they generate a recurrent mechanism of opening inside boundedness. Context repeatedly rematerializes that mechanism as oath and license, settlement and body, road and obstacle, liberation and poverty, reciprocal civic bonds, and finally open boundary versus sealed enclosure. The readings remain coexisting rather than resolving whether the addressee is licensed, exposed, settled, mobile, or an event coming due.
remaining_uncertainties: The legal valence of the focus predicate remains reversible between permission enjoyed by the addressee and protection removed from the addressee.
Temporary alighting, durable residence, and loosening from place are all branch-backed but pull the spatial model in different directions.
The city-as-body, aperture, adornment, and nest models depend on explicit reader-supplied cross-domain mappings and should remain exploratory.
The arrow from the addressee's own release to freeing and feeding others is abductively strong in the sequence but is not grammatically supplied by the focus line alone.
